title: Wav.shaper
excerpt: Waveshaper effect inspired by the WMD Geiger Counter and the Spektro Audio Nucleation Max for...
content:
Waveshaper effect inspired by the WMD Geiger Counter  and the Spektro Audio Nucleation Max for Live device.

Wav.shaper uses 25 different waveforms to shape incoming sounds. All these waveforms were generated using Nucleation and each of them affects the sound differently.

The module features parameters such as input gain, output gain, and dry / wet to let you dial the amount of waveshaping.

The Extra page contains some additional parameters (DC-Offset, HPF and LPF) that also affect the overall sound.

To get the best results out of this module try using it on very dynamic sounds such as drums.

Also keep in mind that changing the waveform while it's playing may glitch the sound for couple of ms while the new waveform is being loaded.
